overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: Runs a credit-card back office online: after sign-on, users view and update accounts and cards, list, view and add transactions, pay a bill and request reports, and administrators maintain the user file.
In batch it posts the daily transaction file to the transaction master and the account balances, calculates monthly interest, and produces statements and transaction reports.
The online screens and the batch jobs work on the same VSAM files: the scheduled chains close those files in the CICS region before their work and reopen them afterwards.

overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: Posts the day's card transactions to the transaction master and the account balances (POSTTRAN, triggered after CBPAUP0J), between a close and a reopen of the online files.
Reloads the transaction type, transaction category and category balance files from flat files, then reads back the account, card, customer and cross-reference masters.
Creates the card statements and converts them to PDF, and prints the transaction category balance report.

overviews.name: DAILY-TransactionBackup
key_points: Backs up the transaction master to a new backup generation with the online files closed, then reopens them after a wait.
TRANBKP deletes and redefines the transaction master after unloading it, and no later step of the job reloads it, so the master is an empty cluster when the chain ends.

overviews.name: WEEKLY-TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Runs the single job MNTTRDB2, whose JCL is not among this module's scanned members, so what it does is not in this inventory; its completion condition is what DisclosureGroupsRefresh and TransactionTypesDBRefresh wait on.

overviews.name: DisclosureGroupsRefresh
key_points: Reloads the disclosure group file - the source of the interest rate the interest calculation reads - from its flat file, with the online files closed, once the weekly MNTTRDB2 job has completed.

overviews.name: TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Runs the single job TRANEXTR once MNTTRDB2 has completed; its JCL is not among this module's scanned members, so what it extracts is not in this inventory.

overviews.name: MONTHLY-InterestCalculation
key_points: Calculates interest on every account's category balances and writes it as system transactions (INTCALC), then merges those with the transaction backup and loads the result into the transaction master (COMBTRAN).
COMBTRAN reads generation (0) of the transaction backup, which this chain does not write: the backup comes from a job outside it (TRANBKP and TRANREPT each write TRANSACT.BKUP(+1)).

descriptions.name: CBACT01C
descriptions.description: Reads the account master VSAM file and writes each account to three sequential outputs (flat, array and variable-length layouts), formatting dates through the assembler routine COBDATFT.

descriptions.name: CBACT02C
descriptions.description: Reads the card data VSAM file sequentially and prints every card record.

descriptions.name: CBACT03C
descriptions.description: Reads the card-to-account cross-reference file sequentially and prints every record.

descriptions.name: CBACT04C
descriptions.description: Calculates monthly interest per account from the transaction-category balances and the disclosure-group rate, writes an interest transaction for each and adds the total to the account balance.
key_points: Interest per category balance is (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200, computed with no ROUNDED phrase (:464-465), and written as a type '01', category '05' transaction whose id is the PARM date plus a running suffix (:474-483).

The account is rewritten with the accumulated interest when the account id changes (:194-196); the only other call sits in the ELSE of IF END-OF-FILE = 'N', inside a loop that ends when END-OF-FILE = 'Y' (:188-221).
1400-COMPUTE-FEES is performed for every non-zero rate but contains no statements (:216, :518-520).

descriptions.name: CBCUS01C
descriptions.description: Reads the customer data VSAM file sequentially and prints every customer record.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Exports customer, account, card cross-reference, transaction and card data from the VSAM files into one multi-record export file for a branch migration.

descriptions.name: CBFEEDRV
descriptions.description: Reads the account master and calls the PL/I late-fee routine CBFEECAL for every account with an overdue cycle, writing one 80-byte fee line per account.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Reads the multi-record branch-migration export file and splits it into separate customer, account, card cross-reference and transaction files, with validation and an error file.

descriptions.name: CBSTM03A
descriptions.description: Prints an account statement for each card from transaction data, in plain text and in HTML, doing its indexed-file access through the subroutine CBSTM03B.

descriptions.name: CBSTM03B
descriptions.description: Subroutine called by the statement program CBSTM03A to do its file handling.

descriptions.name: CBTRN01C
descriptions.description: Reads the daily transaction file against the customer, cross-reference, card, account and transaction files; its header says it posts the records, but every file is opened for input only.

descriptions.name: CBTRN02C
descriptions.description: Posts the daily transaction file: validates each record against the card cross-reference and account, writes rejects with a reason and updates the transaction master, category balances and account.
key_points: A record is rejected when the card number is not on the cross-reference (100), the account is not found (101), the transaction would exceed the credit limit (102) or it arrives after the account expiration date (103) (:380-421).
The over-limit test compares ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT with current-cycle credit minus current-cycle debit plus the transaction amount (:403-413).
The step ends with RETURN-CODE 4 when at least one transaction was rejected (:229-231).

descriptions.name: CBTRN03C
descriptions.description: Prints the transaction detail report for the date range read from the date parameter file, using the cross-reference, transaction type and transaction category files for lookups.

descriptions.name: COACTUPC
descriptions.description: Online account update: accepts and processes changes to an account.

descriptions.name: COACTVWC
descriptions.description: Online account view: accepts an account view request and processes it.

descriptions.name: COADM01C
descriptions.description: Admin menu for administrator users: validates the option entered and transfers control to the program the option table names.

descriptions.name: COBIL00C
descriptions.description: Online bill payment: pays an account's current balance in full, writing a bill-payment transaction and reducing the account balance by the amount paid.
key_points: Payment happens only on confirmation 'Y': the next transaction id is the highest existing id plus one, the record is type '02', category 2, for the full ACCT-CURR-BAL, and the account is then updated (:210-235).
An account whose current balance is zero or negative is refused with 'You have nothing to pay...' (:197-205).

descriptions.name: COBSWAIT
descriptions.description: Batch utility that waits for the number of centiseconds read from SYSIN by calling the routine MVSWAIT.

descriptions.name: COCRDLIC
descriptions.description: Lists credit cards: all cards for an admin user when no context is passed, otherwise only the cards of the account in the COMMAREA.

descriptions.name: COCRDSLC
descriptions.description: Online credit card view: accepts and processes a credit card detail request.

descriptions.name: COCRDUPC
descriptions.description: Online credit card update: accepts a credit card detail request and processes changes to the card.

descriptions.name: COMEN01C
descriptions.description: Main menu for regular users: validates the option entered and transfers control to the program the option table names.
key_points: An option marked admin-only is refused for a regular user (:135-142); the pending-authorization option is offered only when EXEC CICS INQUIRE finds program COPAUS0C installed (:147-168).

descriptions.name: CORPT00C
descriptions.description: Requests transaction reports from the online region by writing the JCL of a batch job to the extra-partition transient data queue JOBS.
key_points: The job cards written are literals in the program: job TRNRPT00 executing PROC TRANREPT with SYMNAMES and DATEPARM overrides carrying the requested date range (:84-116).

descriptions.name: COSGN00C
descriptions.description: Sign-on screen: checks the user id and password against the USRSEC file and transfers to the admin menu or the main menu according to the user type.

descriptions.name: COTRN00C
descriptions.description: Lists transactions from the TRANSACT file a page at a time and passes a selected transaction to the view program.

descriptions.name: COTRN01C
descriptions.description: Displays one transaction from the TRANSACT file.

descriptions.name: COTRN02C
descriptions.description: Adds a new transaction to the TRANSACT file after validating the key and data fields entered.

descriptions.name: COUSR00C
descriptions.description: Lists the users in the USRSEC file a page at a time and passes a selected user to the update or delete program.

descriptions.name: COUSR01C
descriptions.description: Adds a new regular or admin user to the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: COUSR02C
descriptions.description: Updates a user in the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: COUSR03C
descriptions.description: Deletes a user from the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: CSUTLDTC
descriptions.description: Subprogram that checks a date against a format by calling the Language Environment service CEEDAYS and returns a result message and severity code.

descriptions.name: ACCTFILE
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the account VSAM KSDS from the flat file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.PS.

descriptions.name: CARDFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the card files in CICS, deletes, defines and reloads the card data VSAM KSDS, builds its alternate index on account id and reopens the files.

descriptions.name: CBADMCDJ
descriptions.description: Runs DFHCSDUP to define the CardDemo resources of group CARDDEMO (library, mapsets and the definitions that follow) in the CICS CSD.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Defines the export VSAM cluster and runs CBEXPORT to export customer data from the VSAM files for a branch migration.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Runs CBIMPORT to split the multi-record export file into separate customer, account, cross-reference and transaction import files plus an error file.

descriptions.name: CLOSEFIL
descriptions.description: Closes the TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX and USRSEC files in the CICS region CICSAWSA through SDSF modify commands.

descriptions.name: COMBTRAN
descriptions.description: Sorts the transaction backup and the system-generated transactions together by transaction id and loads the combined file into the transaction master VSAM.

descriptions.name: CREASTMT
descriptions.description: Creates a statement for each card on the cross-reference file: rebuilds a transaction work file keyed by card number and transaction id, then runs CBSTM03A to write text and HTML statements.

descriptions.name: CUSTFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the customer file in CICS, deletes, defines and reloads the customer VSAM KSDS from the flat file, then reopens it.

descriptions.name: DALYREJS
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group for the daily rejects file.

descriptions.name: DEFCUST
descriptions.description: Deletes the customer cluster AWS.CCDA.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER and defines the cluster AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER.

descriptions.name: DEFGDGB
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group bases the CardDemo application needs.

descriptions.name: DEFGDGD
descriptions.description: Defines generation data groups for the transaction type, transaction category and disclosure group reference data and creates the first generation of each from the flat files.

descriptions.name: DISCGRP
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the disclosure group VSAM KSDS from the flat file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DISCGRP.PS.

descriptions.name: DUSRSECJ
descriptions.description: Creates the user security file from in-stream data, defines the USRSEC VSAM KSDS and loads it.

descriptions.name: ESDSRRDS
descriptions.description: Creates a sequential user security file from in-stream data and loads it into newly defined ESDS and RRDS VSAM clusters.

descriptions.name: FEECALC
descriptions.description: Month-end late-fee calculation: runs CBFEEDRV, which calls the PL/I routine CBFEECAL for every account, and writes a new LATEFEES generation.

descriptions.name: FTPJCLS
descriptions.description: Runs FTP to send the dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST to a remote server as welcome.txt.

descriptions.name: INTCALC
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT04C over the transaction category balance file to compute interest and fees, writing the system transactions to a new SYSTRAN generation.

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ1
descriptions.description: Copies a test dataset to a backup with IDCAMS REPRO, then submits member INTRDRJ2 through the internal reader.

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ2
descriptions.description: Copies the test backup dataset to a further dataset with IDCAMS REPRO; it is the member INTRDRJ1 writes to the internal reader.

descriptions.name: OPENFIL
descriptions.description: Opens the TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX and USRSEC files in the CICS region CICSAWSA through SDSF modify commands.

descriptions.name: POSTTRAN
descriptions.description: Runs CBTRN02C to post the daily transaction file to the transaction master, update category balances and accounts, and write rejects to a new DALYREJS generation.

descriptions.name: PRTCATBL
descriptions.description: Unloads the transaction category balance file to a backup generation, then sorts and reformats it into the report dataset TCATBALF.REPT.

descriptions.name: READACCT
descriptions.description: Deletes the previous outputs, then runs CBACT01C to read the account master VSAM file and write it to three sequential datasets.

descriptions.name: READCARD
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT02C to read and print the card master VSAM file.

descriptions.name: READCUST
descriptions.description: Runs CBCUS01C to read and print the customer master VSAM file.

descriptions.name: READXREF
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT03C to read and print the card cross-reference VSAM file.

descriptions.name: REPTFILE
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group for the transaction report file.

descriptions.name: TCATBALF
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the transaction category balance VSAM KSDS from the flat file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.PS.

descriptions.name: TRANBKP
descriptions.description: Unloads the transaction master VSAM to a new backup generation, then deletes and redefines the transaction master cluster.

descriptions.name: TRANCATG
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the transaction category type VSAM KSDS from the flat file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANCATG.PS.

descriptions.name: TRANFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the transaction files in CICS, deletes, defines and loads the transaction master VSAM from the initial daily transaction file, builds its alternate index and reopens the files.

descriptions.name: TRANIDX
descriptions.description: Defines the alternate index on processed timestamp over the transaction master, defines its path and builds the index.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: Unloads the transaction master to a backup generation, filters it by date range and sorts it by card number, then runs CBTRN03C to print the transaction detail report.

descriptions.name: TRANTYPE
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the transaction type VSAM KSDS from the flat file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANTYPE.PS.

descriptions.name: TXT2PDF1
descriptions.description: Converts the text statement file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.STATEMNT.PS to a PDF by running the TXT2PDF exec under batch TSO.

descriptions.name: WAITSTEP
descriptions.description: Runs COBSWAIT to wait for the number of centiseconds given in SYSIN (00003600 as written).

descriptions.name: XREFFILE
descriptions.description: Deletes, defines and reloads the card cross-reference VSAM KSDS from the flat file and builds its alternate index.

descriptions.name: REPROC
descriptions.description: IDCAMS REPRO procedure that loads or unloads a VSAM file from DD FILEIN to DD FILEOUT, using control member REPROCT.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: Procedure form of the transaction report: unloads the transaction master, filters by date range and sorts by card number, then runs CBTRN03C; CORPT00C names it in the job it submits.
